lines.trans: This is an elementary setup, dear Arkashenka!
Did you set all this up in advance?
How did you not figure this out?
You are not the same man, not at all!
We made an honest agreement after all.
Your millions will now stay with me.
Give me at least my share.
You will not get another single ruble.
I can call the police right now.
You have no proof whatsoever against me.
You will answer for this vile betrayal.
Time to return to your cramped communal flat.
I will never forgive you for this deception.
Get used to your new modest life.

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: with a past-tense verb: я бы подумал = I would think
wishes: купили бы = we could have bought

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: возвращаться домой = to come back home; к + dative = to someone
at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: to call for, to summon (a taxi, driver, police, doctor)

examples.text: Каждый партнёр получил равную долю прибыли.
examples.trans: Each partner received an equal share of the profit.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: The parties concluded a profitable contract.

meanings.en: in advance, beforehand, ahead of time

examples.trans: Did you set all this up in advance?

examples.text: Мы купили билеты на поезд заранее.
examples.trans: We bought the train tickets in advance.
There's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
colloquial for коммунальная квартира: one flat shared by several families

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
We live in a communal flat.

meanings.note: after numbers: два миллиона, пять миллионов

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: ни копейки = not a penny

examples.trans: I have no money at all.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: He will hand over the money.
You are a despicable man, Borya!

meanings.en: to rig, frame, set up maliciously

examples.trans: Did you set all this up in advance?
The fraudsters engineered a trap for the businessman.

meanings.note: + infinitive: Пора идти = Time to go

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.

examples.text: Ты ответишь за это подлое предательство.
examples.trans: You will answer for this vile betrayal.

examples.text: Он тяжело переживал предательство лучшего друга.
examples.trans: He suffered deeply from the betrayal of his best friend.

meanings.en: to get used to, grow accustomed to

examples.trans: Get used to your new life.
A person quickly gets used to good things.

meanings.en: to figure out, catch on, see through

examples.text: Как же ты этого не просëк?
examples.trans: How did you not figure this out?

examples.text: Опытный сыщик сразу просëк замысел преступников.
examples.trans: The experienced detective instantly saw through the criminals' plan.

meanings.note: + genitive; can stand alone: Я против = I'm against it
подать на развод = to file for divorce

examples.trans: They went through a difficult divorce.
I haven't got a single rouble.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: Привыкай к своей новой скромной жизни.
examples.trans: Get used to your new modest life.
He wore a modest grey suit.

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.text: Пора возвращаться в твою тесную коммуналку.
examples.trans: Time to return to your cramped communal flat.

examples.text: Они жили в маленькой тесной комнате.
examples.trans: They lived in a small cramped room.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

хотя.gloss: even if, at least (with бы); although

meanings.note: нужно хотя бы поговорить = we need at least to talk

examples.text: Нужно хотя бы поговорить с ними.
examples.trans: We need at least to talk with them.
This is an elementary setup for fools.

examples.text: Ученик решил элементарную задачу по математике.
examples.trans: The student solved an elementary math problem.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
